mechanics.claim: Deadly Spines deals magic damage to enemies hit in an area at the target location.
mechanics.quote: sprouts thorny spines at the target location ... dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.

mechanics.claim: The spines appear (and deal damage) 0.625 seconds after cast, not instantly.
If Deadly Spines hits a Seed, it grows into a Thorn Spitter plant that attacks with ranged attacks, adding additional damage over its lifetime beyond the initial cast.
mechanics.quote: If ''Deadly Spine'' hits a ''Seed'', it sprouts into a ... ''Thorn Spitter'' that lasts for 8 seconds.

mechanics.claim: Deadly Spines can be blocked by spell shields.
